AFTER an unequivocal experience of the inefficiency of the subsisting beneath this Monarchy of Oppression, you are called upon to deliberate on a new Constitution for these United Colonies, This Empire of Refuge. 

The present war not withstanding, the leadership of the Empire must be attended to with haste.

The subject speaks to its own importance. And comprehending the consequences of nothing less than our continued existence, the safety and welfare of this last bastion of our freedom, the fate of an empire in many respects the last free people of the Old World. It has been said that it seems to have been reserved to the people of this country, by their conduct and example, to decide the important question, whether societies of men are really capable or not of establishing good government from reflection and choice, or whether they are forever destined to depend for their political constitutions on accident and force. 

If there be any truth in the remark, the crisis at which we are arrived may be regarded as the era in which that decision is to be made; and  the choice in leadership will deserve to be considered as the general fortune of mankind.

Happy will it be if our choice should be directed by a judicious estimate of our true interests, unperplexed and unbiased by considerations not connected with the public good. But this is a thing more ardently to be wished than seriously to be expected. The plan offered to our deliberations affects too many particular interests, innovates upon too many local institutions, not to involve in its discussion a variety of objects foreign to its merits, and of views, passions and prejudices little favorable to the discovery of truth.

(This is where we begin to talk about what kind of country Arcania should be. Your debates and choices will echo in the Tales From Arcania games forever.)
